'''Michael Richard Taylor''' (born August 29, 1972) is an American [[basketball]] coach. He most recently served as head coach  and general manager of the [[Winnipeg Sea Bears]] of the [[Canadian Elite Basketball League]] (CEBL).<ref>{{cite news|last=Prentice|first=Amy-Ellen|title=Winnipeg's new basketball team names first head coach|url=https://globalnews.ca/news/9347973/winnipegs-new-basketball-team-sea-bears-coach/|publisher=Global News|website= global news.ca|date=December 14, 2022|access-date=December 15, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=BREAKING: Winnipeg Sea Bears Name First Head Coach|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/breaking-winnipeg-sea-bears-name-first-head-coach/n-5906615|publisher=OSC|website=oursportscentral.com|date=December 14, 2022|access-date=December 15, 2022}}</ref> Previously, he was head coach of the [[Poland men's national basketball team|Poland national team]],<ref>[https://www.fiba.basketball/news/poland-aim-to-be-the-best '''Poland Aim to Be the Best'''], FIBA.com, 1 June 2015. Accessed 23 May 2016.</ref> which he led to the round of 16 at the [[2015 EuroBasket]]<ref>{{usurped|1=[https://web.archive.org/web/20160701133426/http://www.eurobasket2015.org/en/compID_qMRZdYCZI6EoANOrUf9le2.season_2015.roundID_9322.teamID_347.coachID_3165..html EuroBasket 2015 – Mike Taylor]}}, EuroBasket2015.org, accessed 23 May 2016.</ref> and the quarter-finals of the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup|2019 FIBA World Cup]].

[[File:PZK 20140801 Toruń Basket Cup 3192.jpg|thumb|right|Taylor coaching Poland in 2014]]
Before he coached Poland, he led several professional teams in the United States and Germany.<ref>[http://www.augsburger-allgemeine.de/sport/Ratiopharm-Ulm-will-hoch-hinaus-id14876636.html Ratiopharm Ulm will hoch hinaus], Augsburger Allgemeine, 28 April 2011. Accessed 23 May 2016.{{in lang|de}}</ref><ref>[http://www.basketball-ulm.com/news-archiv/414-mike-taylors-taufe Mike Taylor's Taufe], Basketball-Ulm.com, 22 July 2010. Accessed 23 May 2016.{{in lang|de}}</ref>

==Coaching career==
===Hamburg Towers===
On 23 May 2018, Taylor signed a two-year contract with [[Hamburg Towers]] of the German second tier [[ProA]].
<ref>{{cite web| url = http://www.fiba.basketball/news/a-fan-of-the-game-hamburg-towers-poland-coach-mike-taylor-talks-wheelchair-basketball| title = A fan of the game – Hamburg Towers and Poland coach Mike Taylor talks wheelchair basketball – FIBA.basketball}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.2basketballbundesliga.de/mike-taylor-wird-trainer-der-hamburg-towers/|title=BARMER 2. Basketball Bundesliga – Mike Taylor weird Trainer der Hamburg Towers|publisher=|accessdate=5 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190505090340/https://www.2basketballbundesliga.de/mike-taylor-wird-trainer-der-hamburg-towers/|archive-date=5 May 2019|url-status=dead}}</ref> In his first season, he won the championship with the club and led Hamburg to its first promotion to the [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.2basketballbundesliga.de/proa-meister-1819-hamburg-towers/|title=BARMER 2. Basketball Bundesliga – ProA Meister 18/19 – Hamburg Towers!|publisher=|accessdate=5 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190505090343/https://www.2basketballbundesliga.de/proa-meister-1819-hamburg-towers/|archive-date=5 May 2019|url-status=dead}}</ref>
===Poland===
In 2014, he became the head coach of the Polish national basketball team. He finished 11th at [[EuroBasket 2015]] and 18th at [[EuroBasket 2017]]. His greatest success was finishing 8th at the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup|2019 World Cup]], where he advanced with Poland for the first time since 1967 and then reached the quarterfinals.

== Personal life ==
Mike Taylor’s Dad, Dick Taylor is a former Clarion University Basketball coach and Professor.

In 2013 Taylor married his wife Alice, whom he met while coaching in Ulm, Germany. They have two sons.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-06-05 |title=Former Bobcat Standout Mike Taylor Having Great Success In Professional Basketball Coaching Ranks (06/05/19) |url=https://clarionsportszone.com/2019/06/former-bobcat-standout-mike-taylor-having-great-success-in-professional-basketball-coaching-ranks-06-04-19/ |access-date=2024-12-26 |website=Clarion Sports Zone |language=en}}</ref>
